title: CouncilMember
description: A person serving on a strata council, with any officer role they hold.
x-validationRules: endDate must be on or after startDate.
A council should have at most one active president at any time.
x-legalReviewNotes: Officer roles come from the Standard Bylaws; corporations can amend them. Consider allowing custom roles.

id.description: Stable identifier of this CouncilMember record.

councilId.description: The council the person serves on.

x-enumDescriptions.member: Council member without an officer role.

startDate.description: Date the person started in this role.

endDate.description: Date the person stopped serving in this role, if they have.
